# ATLAS Copy and Microcopy Skill

Use this skill when writing or revising UI text, helper text, errors, and onboarding content.

## Plain-Language Rules
- Use common words over technical terms.
- Keep one idea per sentence.
- Prefer active voice and direct action verbs.

## Message Structure
- `What happened`
- `Why it matters` (short)
- `What to do next`

## Error Copy Requirements
- Identify the specific failed action.
- Provide immediate recovery option if available.
- Avoid blame language.

## Onboarding Rules
- Show one step at a time.
- Highlight one primary action per step.
- Use reassurance copy for unfamiliar tasks.

## QA Check
- If a first-time faculty user cannot explain the next action, rewrite the copy.
